card.name: Words leading into 'succession' or time spans
card.fires_on: The word 'rapid' in 'in rapid succession' after giving repeated injections, and linking words like 'within' or 'in' that lead into a time span for repeated doses.

modes.label: In rapid succession
modes.description: The word 'rapid' just before 'succession' in instructions to give extra injections.
modes.example: administer two additional injections intramuscularly in<< rapid>> succession. ( 2.2 )

modes.label: Within a time span
modes.description: 'within' or 'given' before a period such as 7 days or 24 hours when limiting repeated doses.
modes.example: Do not take more than two 75 mg tablets<< within>> 7 days.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about things happening one after another, such as consecutive, succession and sequential.
card.plain: It marks spots where the text is about doses or events following one another in a row or within a set time.
